## Loading the data

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
tt <- tt_load("2026-07-07")
df <- tt[[1]]
```

## Visualization

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(df, aes(x = height, y = weight)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Height vs Weight", caption = "Source: TidyTuesday | 2026-07-07")
```
